conviction_note: The H1 was pre-released by a Nikkei observation report on 10/21 (OP above ¥50bn, FY plan to be held). OBIC has held its plan at every H1 since 2022, and it announces no shareholder returns at H1. The setup matches the H1 2025 print (pre-report then hold, -5.25% next day, 出尽くし) and Q1 2026 (-0.36%), so this leans slightly negative: abs 3.0 (below the 4.2 history median because nothing new is expected) times p_up 45 gives -0.3, against a findings sum of -0.7. The gap is because LESSONS rule 1 pulls p_up toward 50: the pre-release is public.
bar: H1 operating profit 'above ¥50bn, +10%+ YoY' per the Nikkei observation report relayed by Fisco/kabutan 2026-10-21 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4684&b=n202610210834); FY27/3 company plan OP ¥98,000m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4684); IFIS consensus FY OP ¥100,716m / 経常 ¥117,560m as of 2026-10-26 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4684). The pre-report is a floor ('超えた'), so a print of ~¥50-51bn is about +1% against it.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position ≥0.5%), unchanged, as_of 2026-10-26 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 3.04 on 10/23, down from 5.56 on 9/25 (margin longs 185.7k→114.2k shares, shorts 33.4k→37.6k) per kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=4684): leveraged longs have been taking profit into the rally, so this is not a crowded margin long. The priced lean is -1.2.

findings.finding: Nikkei's observation report of 2026-10-21 already put H1 OP above ¥50bn (+>14% YoY vs ¥43,655m; >51% of the ¥98bn plan, against own H1 progress of 49.4-50.6% for FY23-FY25) and said the FY plan is likely held. OBIC held its plan at every H1 print 2022-2025, so the release is expected to add nothing. Last year's identical setup (pre-report, then hold) sold off 5.25% the next day on 出尽くし.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2025 (2025-10-28 15:30, pre-reported by Nikkei, FY held): -5.25% next close, Fisco '上半期好決算発表もサプライズ乏しく出尽くし感先行'. Q1 2026 (2026-07-22, pre-reported): -0.36%, 'サプライズ限定的'. H1 2024 (2024-10-29, plan held): +4.23%. The prints that rose most (2026-04 +10.6%, 2026-01 +0.6%) carried a buyback and/or a dividend increase.
findings.why_not_priced: The H1 number is priced: the stock rose on the report and has rallied 20% in October. What may not be priced is that the release adds nothing to it. If holders had already treated the H1 as done, the stock would not have kept making record highs into the print on 10/22-10/26, or margin longs would have unwound fully. They are still 3x shorts.
findings.independence: The prior-year reaction is a separate source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4684&b=n202510290538 (2025-10-29). The H1 progress-rate history comes from kabutan's 2025-10-28 決算速報 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4684&b=k202510280023). The pre-report and the plan-hold expectation share one document.

findings.finding: After a +66% rise from the June low of ¥3,643 and +20% in October, the stock sits about 10.7% above the IFIS consensus target of ¥5,405. The 10/23 session showed a high-volume reversal (open ¥6,010, close ¥5,870, 3.0m shares, about 1.7x the 20-day norm), so valuation has run past what the sell-side has written down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Large run-ups into prints show no consistent sign for this name: +13.1% 20d into 2025-04 → +2.57%; +5.7% into 2026-04 → +10.62%; +12.9% into 2026-07 → -0.36% (Yahoo daily closes, computed).

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this overlaps the run-up the free control already holds. What it adds is the gap to target. Sell-side targets usually rise after OBIC prints (kabutan rating digests 2025-10-30 格上げ, 2026-07-29 目標株価を増額), and that can close the gap from either side, which is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: Daily bars: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/4684.T?range=3mo&interval=1d. The June low comes from a Matsui/traders snippet.

findings.finding: The ¥50bn buyback resolved on 2026-04-21 (to 2027-03-31) had ¥21.3bn executed by 9/30, ¥4.07bn of it in September alone. Market buying continues through the window, but no new return programme or dividend change is expected at H1: the interim forecast of ¥47 was set in April, and last year's extra buyback (ToSTNeT-3) came on 11/6, nine days after the H1 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-21: FY print with a new ¥50bn buyback and a higher dividend, +10.62%. 2026-01-26: Q3 print with a year-end dividend raise, +0.57%. 2025-10-28: H1 print with no returns, -5.25%.
findings.why_not_priced: The ongoing buyback is public and priced as a programme. What remains is the steady daily bid (about ¥0.2bn a day against ¥9bn of turnover) cushioning a post-print dip, plus a small chance of a surprise return. Both are small.
findings.independence: Last year's timing of the separate buyback: kabutan news list 2025-11-06 16:30 自己株式取得に係る事項の決定 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4684&nmode=0&date=20251100).

outside_window.finding: H1 OP running above own-history progress (>51% vs 49-51%) points to FY OP of about ¥100bn+ against the ¥98bn plan. OBIC historically books this beat at the FY print (FY26/3: plan ¥86.2bn, actual ¥88.8bn) or lifts the dividend at Q3, not at H1.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the priced lean (-1.2, run-up driven) and adds little to it. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward FY revision (never done at H1 in four years), a surprise extra buyback or dividend (last year's came nine days later), or a Q2 well above the '>¥50bn' floor. I looked for all three and found nothing pointing to any of them, and falling margin longs mean there is no crowded seller, so the negative is kept small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on what the market already has): finding 1 rests on a public pre-report, so it went from -1.0 to -0.7 and p_up from 42 to 45. The release is expected to add nothing either way.
Open question 4 (a run-in as a short signal failed once): the run-up/target-gap finding went from -0.4 to -0.2.
Rule 2: wrote the strongest possible positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for it; that changed nothing further.
The capital-return finding (+0.2), abs_move_pct 3.0 and print_vs_bar +1.0 were left unchanged.
